facts.claim: Lactalis India operates in the dairy product manufacturing industry, producing cheeses, milk, cream, butter, ultra‑fresh, milk powder and related products.
facts.source_snippet:
Industry
Dairy Product Manufacturing

Company Size
1,001-5,000 employees ... Lactalis is a family‑owned dairy group ... Its range of products has grown considerably (cheeses, milk, cream, butter, ultra‑fresh, milk powder, etc.)

facts.claim: Lactalis entered the Indian market in 2014 by acquiring the South Indian dairy producer Thirumala Milk Products Private Limited.
facts.source_snippet: In 2014, Groupe Lactalis entered India after acquiring, the leading South Indian dairy production company Thirumala Milk Products Private Limited.

facts.claim: In India the group sells through regional brands Tirumala, Anik, Prabhat and international brands President and Lactel.
facts.source_snippet: In India, the group now sells through its regional brands Tirumala, Anik, Prabhat as well as its international brands President and Lactel.

facts.claim: Lactalis India aims to become a US$1 billion company in India within the next five to seven years.
facts.source_snippet: “Within five to seven years, we intend to become a US$1 billion company in India,” he says, reinforcing that the company is on track to achieving its goal.

facts.claim: Lactalis India partnered with DHL SmarTrucking to provide customized cold‑chain transportation for its two Indian dairy companies, using IoT‑enabled smart technology for temperature accuracy and faster transit.
facts.source_snippet: Lactalis India … has signed on DHL SmarTrucking as a logistics partner for two of its companies. DHL SmarTrucking will provide customized cold chain transportation solutions for Thirumala Milk Products Private Limited ... and Anik Dairy ... Employing smart technology to ensure temperature accuracy and reliability ... leveraging Internet of Things (IoT) technology and data-driven insights for shorter transit times and a faster turnaround on vehicle availability.

facts.claim: Lactalis India describes itself as an integrated milk and dairy products company in India with a state‑of‑the‑art plant, cutting‑edge technology and stringent quality standards.
facts.source_snippet: We are an integrated milk and dairy products company in India, With the state-of-the-art plant, cutting edge technology and stringent quality standards.

facts.claim: Lactalis India launched "Quality Nexpert", its first quality capability development program in India, aimed at strengthening technical depth and elevating quality standards for its plant and operations staff.
facts.source_snippet: We are proud to announce the successful launch of Quality Nexpert, our first ever Quality capability development program in India — thoughtfully designed and inspired by the Group Academies. This year long, highly customised program has been crafted exclusively for our Quality Champions across Lactalis India, focusing on strengthening technical depth, elevating quality standards, and building the next generation of quality experts who will lead our plants and operations with precision and excellence.

facts.claim: In a Leadership Connect session, Shujaat Ali Shah, General Manager Operations – Bisconni (Lactalis India), discussed manufacturing excellence and provided a detailed look at modern baking manufacturing plant operations and key drivers of operational and quality excellence.
facts.source_snippet: Drawing from his professional journey, Shujaat shared valuable perspectives on Manufacturing Excellence, tracing the evolution of industrial revolutions, offering a closer look at the workings of a modern baking manufacturing plant, and outlining the key drivers of operational and quality excellence.
